title: kith-peer: never-hold-MutexGuard-across-await lock discipline is correct
description: outbox_tick drops the store lock before every .await. MutexGuard<Store> is \!Send so the compiler would reject holding it across an await — this is a compile-time guarantee. A contributor might try to 'simplify' by holding longer; that would deadlock. The pattern is correct and should be preserved.
